captions.formal: Motion-blurred vehicles travel in both directions along a wide, multi-lane urban road lined with trees displaying bright yellow autumn foliage, under a hazy sky. A building on the left side features signage reading "KOREA LEVELS ENGINEERING" and "TAS PARK INSURANCE," along with a green awning and a Starbucks logo.
captions.sarcastic: The road, wide and bustling with motion-blurred vehicles, hosts a truly groundbreaking spectacle: trees with yellow leaves, a hazy sky, and a building proudly displaying “KOREA LEVELS ENGINEERING” and “TAS PARK INSURANCE” — because nothing says urban progress like a Starbucks under a green awning.
captions.humorous_tech: Motion-blurred vehicles sprint through a time-lapse urban road like a high-latency prod incident, where trees in bright yellow foliage are the only debuggable elements. The building on the left, with "KOREA LEVELS ENGINEERING" and "TAS PARK INSURANCE," logs its Starbucks awning as a minor UI inconsistency.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Cars, buses, and trucks race past like they’re all late for the same very important meeting, their motion-blurred streaks painting the wide urban road as if time itself is in a hurry. The trees in bright yellow foliage look like they’re judging the chaos, while the building with “KOREA LEVELS ENGINEERING” and a Starbucks logo seems to be the only one with a sense of calm — and maybe a good latte.

captions.formal: A small, fluffy orange kitten with large, round eyes and a pink nose walks forward toward the camera on dry, light-brown soil, surrounded by green leafy vines and branches. Its tail rises and remains upright as it moves, with bright natural lighting casting distinct shadows from the foliage.
captions.sarcastic: An orange kitten with the confidence of a tiny, fluffy dictator slowly marches toward the camera, tail held like a royal scepter, as if this patch of dry soil and vines is its personal throne room. The lighting is so bright it’s practically judging the kitten’s life choices.
captions.humorous_tech: A fluffy orange kitten deploys its forward walk with surgical precision, paws stepping in sequence like a well-tested CI pipeline, tail upright as a status indicator, all under bright natural lighting in a garden that’s clearly not on the dev team’s radar.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A fluffy orange kitten with eyes like tiny saucers marches toward the camera like it’s auditioning for a tiny, furry presidential campaign, tail straight up as if it’s carrying a flag. The dry soil and leafy vines look like they’re just background noise to this serious, adorable mission.

captions.formal: A woman with dark curly hair in a high bun sits at a white desk in a modern office, typing on a white keyboard with bright pink fingernails while occasionally glancing to her right. She wears a light beige button-up shirt over a peach-colored top, and a small cross pendant necklace is visible as she works in front of a silver desktop monitor.
captions.sarcastic: A woman with dark curly hair in a high bun performs the groundbreaking task of typing on a white keyboard, occasionally glancing to her right as if her screen might suddenly reveal a new human achievement—like, say, Wi-Fi that actually works.
captions.humorous_tech: A woman with dark curly hair in a high bun debugs her morning standup by typing furiously on a white keyboard, her bright pink nails flashing like error logs as she glances right—probably checking if her monitor’s latency is lower than her boss’s patience.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A woman with dark curly hair in a high bun types away at her white desk like her job depends on it—because, honestly, her boss’s coffee break does. She glances right occasionally, as if someone’s about to walk in and say, “You’re doing great… for now.”

captions.formal: Water cascades forcefully over dark, jagged rocks on a steep cliff face, generating mist that drifts across the frame. The cliff is partially covered in green moss and vegetation, with small trees and shrubs visible along the edges under diffused natural lighting.
captions.sarcastic: A waterfall, clearly determined to be dramatic, plummets over dark, jagged rocks with such effort that it produces mist—because apparently, the cliff needed a humidifier. The surrounding moss and shrubs look mildly impressed, if not slightly damp.
captions.humorous_tech: A waterfall deploys its continuous cascade over dark, jagged rocks in a prod environment, generating mist as a side effect—no human intervention, no merge conflicts, just pure, unbroken flow. The surrounding moss and shrubs run silent health checks, reporting 100% humidity.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A waterfall, clearly overworked, dumps tons of water over dark, jagged rocks like it’s trying to clean the cliff face before the boss arrives. The moss and shrubs look on with quiet resignation, as if they’ve seen this drama every single day and still can’t believe it’s happening again.

captions.formal: A slow, continuous pan from left to right reveals a city skyline at dusk, featuring numerous high-rise buildings with illuminated windows under a darkening blue sky. A tall modern building with an angled facade and vertical blue lighting becomes prominent in the foreground, while a lit "G" logo and a structure with a white crown-like top are visible in the background.
captions.sarcastic: A slow pan across a city skyline at dusk reveals a tall building with an angled facade and vertical blue lighting—clearly the most dramatic architectural statement since someone decided a rooftop pool needed its own spotlight. The “G” logo in the background? Probably just a minor detail.
captions.humorous_tech: The city skyline at dusk deploys its nightly lighting sequence in a smooth left-to-right pan, with the angled blue-lit skyscraper rising like a feature branch ready for merge. The "G" logo and crown-topped building run in background processes, while the rooftop pool debugs its glow in the foreground.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A slow pan across the city skyline at dusk reveals a tall, blue-lit building with an angled facade that seems to be trying way too hard to be the star of the show, while a rooftop pool glows below like it’s waiting for a party that might never happen.

captions.formal: A large flock of white seagulls with black heads and red legs stands on a paved area near calm water, with some birds flying above or landing on the ground. Dark-colored pigeons appear among them, walking on the pavement, under diffuse overcast lighting with hazy mountains in the background.

The pigeons that later join are clearly the latecomers who just showed up for snacks.
captions.humorous_tech: A flock of seagulls—white with black heads and red legs—runs a continuous deployment on the pavement near calm water, with birds taking off and landing like hotfixes in prod. Later, pigeons join the standup, walking in as latecomers with no pull request approval.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A flock of seagulls—white with black heads and red legs—holds a serious pavement powwow near calm water, while others fly overhead like they’re arguing over airspace. Then pigeons waltz in, unfazed, as if the whole gathering was just a minor inconvenience to their afternoon stroll.

captions.formal: A black sedan, a green and white taxi, and a white truck navigate a busy urban intersection with multiple wide crosswalks, where pedestrians cross in various directions. The scene is captured from a fixed high-angle view, showing modern buildings, trees, and a blue and white sign with Japanese characters.

captions.humorous_tech: A black sedan, green-and-white taxi, and white truck navigate a high-angle urban intersection like a multi-threaded system under load—pedestrians cross in synchronized bursts, while the blue-and-white Japanese sign logs every step as a debug trace.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A black sedan, green-and-white taxi, and white truck weave through a busy city intersection like they’re in a traffic ballet, while pedestrians cross in every direction as if the crosswalks are personal VIP lanes. The blue-and-white Japanese sign watches it all with the quiet judgment of a veteran bystander.

captions.formal: A player in neon yellow cleats and black socks kicks a white and blue soccer ball forward on an artificial turf field during twilight. The ball is then pursued by a player in blue cleats and a blue shirt, followed by two players in blue and maroon shirts running side by side away from the camera toward the far end of the field, with a black fence and goalposts visible in the background.
captions.sarcastic: A player in neon yellow cleats kicks a white and blue ball on artificial turf at twilight, and the ensuing chase involves a blue-shirted runner and a maroon-shirted companion sprinting away in perfect, unremarkable synchrony—clearly the pinnacle of soccer’s most thrilling moments.
captions.humorous_tech: A player in neon yellow cleats deploys the white-and-blue ball forward on artificial turf at twilight, triggering a chain reaction as teammates sprint toward the far end—like a critical feature rollout with zero rollback plan. The camera, stuck on static, watches the merge conflict unfold in real time.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A player in neon yellow cleats boots the ball like it owes him money, and the chase is on—blue-shirted runner and maroon-shirted sidekick sprinting away as if the last slice of pizza is at stake, all under a sky turning pink like it’s embarrassed by the drama.

Smoke rises as the grill logs critical browning, and the dark background keeps the fire’s latency low.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A black pan full of chopped veggies—onions, mushrooms, peppers, zucchini—dances over roaring flames like it’s auditioning for a cooking show, tossing and flipping with smoke and fire as its audience. captions.sarcastic: Water droplets fall with the kind of dramatic flair usually reserved for soap operas, while sunlight behind the leaves creates a lens flare so intense it’s practically auditioning for a nature documentary. captions.humorous_tech: The tree branches and leaves form a static, dark silhouette debugged by falling water droplets, while sunlight from behind triggers a lens flare cascade — by the final frame, the moisture has deployed a faint rainbow arc in the lower-left, a visual bug fix for the overexposed background.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Dark branches and bright green leaves stand guard like nature’s shy performers, letting water droplets do the acting while sunlight backlights them like a stagehand with a torch — and by the end, a tiny rainbow sneaks in, just to remind everyone the drama was worth it.

captions.humorous_tech: A person in black-rimmed glasses stares down a relentless stream of scrolling, blurred code like a dev in a 3 AM prod incident—eyes locked, no panic, just pure, focused latency. The dim glow from the screen reflects in their light eyes, as if debugging their own face.
